description: Set up the rust-analyzer-mcp server and guide semantic Rust navigation, diagnostics, and refactoring.

defaultPrompt: Use Rust Analyzer MCP to trace this Rust symbol and its references.

interface.longDescription: Install the rust-analyzer component and the rust-analyzer-mcp server from crates.io, then connect its local stdio MCP process to Codex. Includes workspace selection, semantic navigation, diagnostics, completions, and guidance for reviewing returned edits. Requires a Rust toolchain.
